_note: Open-items ledger. Papers confirmed MISSED by the tracker and then keyword-fixed, but not yet published in any report. A keyword fix is forward-looking only: it changes what future runs can retrieve, it does NOT carry the specific paper into a report, and the moving harvest window immediately steps past the paper's posting date. This ledger is the carry-forward guarantee. DRAIN IT AT THE START OF EVERY RUN: fetch each status="open" item's metadata, score it with the current scorer, include it if it passes Quality Standards, then set status="resolved" and reported=<YYYY-MM-DD>. If it fails the relevance bar, set status="dropped" with a reason. See prompts/daily-paper-tracker.md -> 'Open-items ledger'.
